current_round_corrections: Initial root Java toolchain and full series regression failures are retained as failed logs, followed by explicit final green build logs and zero-failure XML totals.

The first isolated copy and hostname-correction attempts hit Windows long-path errors; original logs remain, and the separate short gp2 preparation/configuration records identify successful replacements.
Paper run-1 rejected a localhost resource URL. The client still requires 127.0.0.1; the server self-host address was explicitly corrected, rather than relaxing the client check.

Paper run-2 exposed the pinned protocol schema mismatch for custom_click_action. The gameplay-only schema now uses native length-prefixed optional NBT, independently decoded by the actual Paper codec.
Paper run-3 passed seed and native Dialog but genuinely lost the unpadded chair on recovery. API placement had omitted its source item; the failure was not accepted or weakened.

The corrected seed supplies each exact registered CE item with count one in FurniturePersistentData before native placement, matching CE 26.9.1 FurnitureItemBehavior.place. Verify and empty do not set, reconstruct, or refund source items.

Folia run-1 completed its client seed and exited normally but still failed strictly on a 19:55:10 startup-region watchdog at ChunkFullTask.run:98 (5.9948197 seconds). Its logs, JFR, runtime and source archive are retained. The cause and fix remain OPEN even if a later isolated retry passes.

Folia run-2 also completed its client seed with normal exits but failed the unchanged strict console gate on the Yggdrasil public-key TLS handshake EOF. Its separate failure, configuration, runtime and source evidence remain retained; successful gameplay checks do not replace a clean complete suite.

Folia run-3 failed when the server exited unexpectedly with Windows status 4294967295 (-1), the client reported ECONNRESET, and no normal stop was recorded. Its cause is unproven; an earlier Windows low-memory observation is only a lead, not a demonstrated explanation.

Folia run-4 passed seed but genuinely failed verify while walking the clear lane to recover the board. Red carpet and chair recovery had already passed, the server had no console errors and stopped normally, but these partial successes do not override the movement timeout. A final position near the target alone does not establish a collision cause.

The shared walking helper now stops forward movement before force-look, rechecks arrival and any moved target after rotation, and retains bounded physical diagnostics on failure. Its existing 5000 ms limit and exact drop/component conservation checks remain unchanged; 21 walking contracts remain in the final Node suite.

Paper run-5 passed seed but failed chair recovery after bounded live-hitbox attacks. The old two-player full snapshots between attacks could exceed CE 26.9.1 native 2000 ms consecutive-hit reset window. The corrected observer reads native hit/break receipts between at most three real attacks, checks required hit counts, inclusive time bounds, actor, region and final cancellation, then separately checks full inventories and canonical world drops. No production drop rule or conservation assertion was weakened; 37 new contracts bring both final Node families to 207 total.

Paper run-4 is retained as a successful historical protocol candidate only. The shared walking source changed afterward, so its old source lock cannot accept the current candidate; both final platforms must pass all three starts using identical current scenario hashes.
